FROM dim_store s WHERE s.store_name ILIKE '%Palokka%' OR s.city ILIKE '%Jyv%'

calls.statement:
SELECT week_ending_date, store_key, product_key, closing_units, closing_value, receipts_units, adjustment_units, etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_stock_week WHERE store_key = 30 AND product_key = 11 AND week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-08-30'
ORDER BY week_ending_date, etl_loaded_at
SELECT max(week_ending_date) mx, count(*) n, count(distinct (store_key, product_key, week_ending_date)) nd FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-09-20'

SELECT d.fiscal_week_end_date, d.fiscal_week, sum(f.quantity) units_sold, count(*) lines
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=124 AND p.sku=100011 AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-24'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT w.week_ending_date, count(*) n, sum(closing_units) units, max(etl_loaded_at) loaded
FROM fact_stock_week w WHERE week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-08-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT w.week_ending_date, count(*) n, count(distinct w.product_key) np, sum(w.closing_units) units, sum(closing_units*0) z
FROM fact_stock_week w JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=w.store_key WHERE s.store_id=124 AND week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-08-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
